vars.name: CRON_SECRET
vars.description: Secret token used by Vercel Cron or scheduled runners to authorize cron API endpoints (e.g. app/api/cron/fraud-flags). Matches Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET> header.

vars.name: MEDIA_URL_SIGNING_SECRET
vars.description: Optional secret used by /api/media/[cid] to issue signed, time-limited URLs (lib/mediaUrlSigning.ts). When set, every media URL is HMAC-signed and expires after a configurable window. Leave blank locally — the proxy falls back to referrer-only gating when this is unset. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32 Server-side only — never expose to the client or commit to version control.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_ADDRESS
vars.description: Stellar public key of the platform admin wallet. Any connected wallet matching this address gets access to the /admin panel. Leave blank during development. WARNING: if unset in production, any connected wallet is treated as admin.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
vars.description: Base URL of the off-chain Node.js backend API (server/). Default for local development: http://localhost:4000

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_ID
vars.description: NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_ID is not set. The Soroban contract ID must be configured before any on-chain operations will work. Set it in your hosting environment or .env.local file.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_DOMAIN
vars.description: Public domain of this deployment (without protocol), used in SEP-10 challenges. Example: scoutoff.app (production) or localhost:3000 (local dev)

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_HORIZON_URL
vars.description: Stellar Horizon REST API endpoint. Used for account queries and transaction submission. Testnet default: https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org Mainnet:        https://horizon.stellar.org

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_IPFS_GATEWAY
vars.description: Public IPFS gateway used to serve stored media (player photos, highlight reels). Default: https://gateway.pinata.cloud/ipfs Any IPFS-compatible gateway works (e.g. https://ipfs.io/ipfs or a custom one).

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_NETWORK
vars.description: Stellar network to target. Use 'testnet' for development, 'mainnet' for production.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SOROBAN_RPC
vars.description: Soroban RPC endpoint for smart-contract reads and simulations. Testnet default: https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org Mainnet:        https://soroban-rpc.stellar.org

vars.name: SESSION_SECRET
vars.description: Secret used to HMAC-sign the `session`/`session_refresh` cookies issued after a successful SEP-10 verification (see lib/session.ts). REQUIRED — routes that read the session cookie throw if this is unset. Use a long, random value (e.g. `openssl rand -base64 48`) and never commit the real value. Rotating it immediately invalidates every outstanding session.

vars.name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
vars.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key, used to verify the challenge token submitted with POST /referrals/generate. Leave blank to skip verification (local dev / tests).

vars.name: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN
vars.description: Bearer token for the Upstash Redis REST API. Server-side only — never expose to the client or commit to version control.

vars.name: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL
vars.description: Full REST URL of your Upstash Redis database (e.g. https://<db>.upstash.io).

vars.name: ADMIN_AUDIT_DB_PATH
vars.description: Filesystem path to the admin audit log's SQLite database (lib/adminAuditStore.ts). Leave blank to use the built-in default location.

vars.name: ANALYZE
vars.description: Optional Next.js bundle analysis switch. Set to 'true' when running the configured bundle analyzer.

vars.name: API_URL_INTERNAL
vars.description: Server-only override for SSR / Server Component fetches (e.g. Docker Compose container-internal hostname: http://mock-api:4000). Leave blank outside of docker-compose — lib/api.ts falls back to NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL when unset.

vars.name: CHUNKED_UPLOAD_DB_PATH
vars.description: Filesystem path to the chunked-upload chunk-bytes SQLite database (lib/chunkedUploadChunkStore.ts, issue #1175). Must point at a shared volume reachable from every instance in a multi-instance deployment — a path on per-instance ephemeral disk reintroduces the same "chunk landed on one instance, invisible to another" bug this store exists to fix. Leave blank to use the built-in default location (fine for local dev).

vars.name: CONTRACT_ID
vars.description: Deployed ScoutOff Soroban contract address the indexer watches. Required.

vars.name: CORS_ORIGIN
vars.description: Legacy single allowed origin; prefer CORS_ORIGINS.

vars.name: CORS_ORIGINS
vars.description: Comma-separated origins allowed to make cross-origin requests. CORS_ORIGIN (a single origin) is still honored for backward compatibility.

vars.name: CORS_ORIGIN_PATTERN
vars.description: Optional regex for extra allowed origins, e.g. Vercel preview deployments: ^https://scout-off-[a-z0-9-]+\.vercel\.app$

vars.name: DB_PATH
vars.description: Path to the SQLite database file. Defaults to ./data/scout-off.db (relative to server/) when unset.

vars.name: E2E_ADMIN_SECRET
vars.description: Stellar secret key for the admin wallet used by admin-flow e2e specs (e.g. fee withdrawal). Testnet only.

vars.name: E2E_CONTRACT_ID
vars.description: Soroban contract ID the e2e suite targets. Specs that need a live contract (e.g. wallet-connect-registration) skip themselves when this is unset.

vars.name: E2E_PORT
vars.description: Port the local dev server binds to for e2e runs. Default: 3100

vars.name: E2E_WALLET_SECRET
vars.description: Stellar secret key for the wallet fixture e2e specs sign transactions with. Testnet only — never use a mainnet key here.

vars.name: FRAUD_FLAGS_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
vars.description: Minimum spacing between on-demand fraud-flag evaluations triggered from FraudFlagsPanel.tsx (app/api/admin/fraud-flags). Defaults to 30000 (30s) when unset. The NEXT_PUBLIC_ variant is read as a fallback so a preview deployment can tune it without a server-only var; the server-only value wins when both are set.

vars.name: HEALTH_MAX_LEDGER_LAG
vars.description: Ledgers the indexer may trail the network by before /health reports `degraded`. Default: 100.

vars.name: INDEXER_API_URL_INTERNAL
vars.description: Server-only base URL of the off-chain event indexer API. The browser never calls the indexer directly: it goes through the same-origin, rate-limited proxy at /api/indexer/*, which forwards to this URL, so the indexer can stay on a private network. Default for local development: http://localhost:3001

vars.name: INDEXER_DB_PATH
vars.description: Filesystem path to the indexer's SQLite database file. Leave blank to use the built-in default location.

vars.name: JSON_BODY_LIMIT
vars.description: Max JSON request body size; larger bodies get a 413.

vars.name: NETWORK_PASSPHRASE
vars.description: Network passphrase for the target Stellar network. Testnet default: 'Test SDF Network ; September 2015' Mainnet:        'Public Global Stellar Network ; September 2015'

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
vars.description: Canonical public URL of the app. Used for PWA manifest start_url, Open Graph tags, and sitemap generation. Update to your production domain before deploying.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
vars.description: Canonical base URL of the frontend (e.g. https://scoutoff.app). Used as a convenience single-origin entry folded into SEP10_ALLOWED_ORIGINS and for absolute URL generation. Leave blank to derive from NEXT_PUBLIC_DOMAIN.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_DARK_MODE_TOGGLE
vars.description: Enables dark mode toggle in the navigation bar. When disabled, the app always renders in dark mode (the default theme).

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_DATA_EXPORT
vars.description: Enables the "Download my data" self-service export in the player dashboard. Exports profile vitals, progress level, milestone history, and IPFS media references as a JSON file.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_FRAUD_AUTO_THROTTLE
vars.description: Enables admin-gated auto-throttling for the two highest-confidence fraud heuristics (cross_scout_redeemer_ring, self_redemption). A matching wallet is automatically blocked from further redemptions/pay-to-contact until an admin explicitly lifts it in FraudFlagsPanel.tsx — never auto-expires. Leave disabled until thresholds in lib/fraudDetection.ts have been tuned against real traffic; see docs/fraud-detection.md.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_IN_APP_NOTIFICATIONS
vars.description: Enables in-app notification system for milestone approvals and scout messages. Disabled by default until the feature is complete.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FRAUD_FLAGS_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
vars.description: Client-visible minimum interval between fraud-flag refreshes; mirrors FRAUD_FLAGS_MIN_INTERVAL_MS.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_INDEXER_API_URL
vars.description: Deprecated: used only as a fallback when INDEXER_API_URL_INTERNAL is unset.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN
vars.description: Sentry DSN (Data Source Name) for client-side error reporting. Leave blank to disable Sentry entirely. Obtain from: https://sentry.io — project → Settings → DSN.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SEP10_HOME_DOMAIN
vars.description: Same value as SEP10_HOME_DOMAIN, exposed to the browser for client-side challenge validation (manageData name "<domain> auth" / web_auth_domain). Keep in sync with SEP10_HOME_DOMAIN.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SEP10_SERVER_ACCOUNT
vars.description: Public key (G…) corresponding to SEP10_SERVER_KEY. Exposed to the browser so the wallet connect flow can independently verify that a challenge XDR is sourced from this account before asking any wallet to sign (SEP-10 client validation). Must match Keypair.fromSecret(SEP10_SERVER_KEY).publicKey().

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STATUS_PAGE_URL
vars.description: URL of the public status page (e.g. Instatus, Better Stack, UptimeRobot) that monitors the frontend, backend API, and Stellar endpoints. Leave blank to hide the live-status link on the /status page.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
vars.description: Public site key for the Cloudflare Turnstile bot-protection widget shown on unauthenticated public forms (e.g. referral code generation). Leave blank to disable the challenge locally — the server-side check is skipped when its corresponding secret is unset (see server/.env.example). Obtain from: https://dash.cloudflare.com — Turnstile → Add widget.

vars.name: PINATA_API_KEY
vars.description: Pinata API key for IPFS uploads via the server-side proxy (app/api/ipfs/upload). Obtain from: https://app.pinata.cloud/keys — create a key with pinFileToIPFS scope. Server-side only — never expose to the client or commit to version control.

vars.name: PINATA_SECRET
vars.description: Pinata API secret paired with PINATA_API_KEY. Server-side only — never expose to the client or commit to version control.

vars.name: PINJSON_CACHE_TTL_MS
vars.description: In-memory TTL (milliseconds) for cached pinned-JSON reads in lib/pinJson.ts. Leave blank to use the built-in default. Must be a positive integer if set.

vars.name: PLATFORM_CONTACT_FEE_XLM
vars.description: XLM fee charged to scouts for pay-to-contact unlocks. Default: 1 (1 XLM).

vars.name: POLL_INTERVAL_MS
vars.description: How often (milliseconds) the indexer polls for new events. Leave blank to use the built-in default.

vars.name: PORT
vars.description: TCP port the server listens on. Set by your host platform in production. Leave blank locally — Next.js defaults to 3000.

vars.name: RATE_LIMIT_MAX
vars.description: Max requests per IP per window for all API routes.

vars.name: RATE_LIMIT_TURNSTILE_MAX
vars.description: Max Turnstile-protected requests per IP per window.

vars.name: RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS
vars.description: Per-IP rate limits: all requests, write methods, and Turnstile routes.

vars.name: RATE_LIMIT_WRITE_MAX
vars.description: Max write requests per IP per window.

vars.name: RECONCILIATION_WEBHOOK_URL
vars.description: Optional server-side webhook URL used to notify the backend about reconciliation events.

vars.name: REDIS_URL
vars.description: When set, rate-limit counters are shared through Redis.

vars.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.description: How long (ms) a client may take to send a complete request.

vars.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
vars.description: Sentry auth token for source-map uploads (build-time only). Server-side only — never expose to the client or commit to version control.

vars.name: SENTRY_ORG
vars.description: Sentry organisation slug (build-time only — set as a CI/host secret). Leave blank locally to skip the source-map upload step during `next build`.

vars.name: SENTRY_PROJECT
vars.description: Sentry project slug (build-time only — set as a CI/host secret).

vars.name: SENTRY_RELEASE
vars.description: Sentry release identifier injected at build time (e.g. a git SHA or semver tag). Automatically set in CI; leave blank locally.

vars.name: SEP10_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
vars.description: Comma-separated list of allowed Origin headers for the SEP-10 POST endpoint (app/api/auth/sep10/route.ts). REQUIRED before deploying to any non-local environment. If unset in production the route fails closed (403). Example: Leave blank locally — dev falls back to http://<NEXT_PUBLIC_DOMAIN>.

vars.name: SEP10_HOME_DOMAIN
vars.description: Home domain asserted in SEP-10 challenge transactions. Must match the deployed origin (e.g. scoutoff.app). For local development use: localhost:3000

vars.name: SEP10_SERVER_KEY
vars.description: Stellar secret key for the SEP-10 server that issues and verifies challenges. Server-side only — never expose to the client or commit to version control.

vars.name: SOROBAN_RPC_URL
vars.description: Soroban RPC endpoint the indexer polls for contract events. Required.

vars.name: START_LEDGER
vars.description: Ledger sequence to start polling from on first run. Leave blank to start from the most recent ledger.

vars.name: TRUST_PROXY_HOPS
vars.description: Number of reverse proxies in front of the server (so req.ip is the client).

vars.name: ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SEC
vars.description: Optional. See .env.example and playwright.config.ts.

vars.name: COINGECKO_API_KEY
vars.description: Optional. See .env.example and lib/xlmRate.ts.

vars.name: COINGECKO_API_PLAN
vars.description: Optional. See .env.example and lib/xlmRate.ts.

vars.name: CONTRACT_VERSION
vars.description: Optional. See .env.example and packages/indexer/src/eventPoller.ts.

vars.name: CV_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY
vars.description: Optional. See .env.example and lib/cvSigning.ts.

vars.name: CV_SIGNING_SECRET
vars.description: Optional. See .env.example and lib/cvSigning.ts.

vars.name: DEFAULT_REFRESH_TTL_SEC
vars.description: Optional. See .env.example and the code.

vars.name: DISPUTE_RESPONSE_WINDOW_MS
vars.description: Optional. See .env.example and lib/milestoneDisputeStore.ts.

vars.name: LOG_LEVEL
vars.description: Optional. See .env.example and packages/indexer/src/logger.ts.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
vars.description: Optional. See .env.example and hooks/usePushNotifications.ts.

vars.name: REMEMBER_ME_REFRESH_TTL_SEC
vars.description: Optional. See .env.example and the code.
